About Me

I am a master’s student in Architectural Engineering at Pusan National University, under the supervision of Prof. JungHo Jeon.

My research interests span computer vision, multimodal sensing, and human-centered AI for construction applications. I have explored human state assessment and automated safety monitoring through AI-driven approaches. My ultimate goal is to develop intelligent systems that better understand workers and their environments to support safer and more effective construction practices.
